'''2000 Illinois State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Illinois in spring 2000. [[Paul Motz]] posted the Ralltiir Operations deck that went 3–0 there "with rather large victory margins".<ref name="dt-4982">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4982 Corellia Ralltiir Operations], DeckTech (Paul "Vollerian" Motz, 2 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4982/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4982/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 1 April 2000<ref name="tr-d452" />
* '''Site:''' Illinois; Normal, Illinois<ref name="tr-d452" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
